summary: This directory contains the testing suite for the entity management layer, focusing on validating the integrity of data structures, schema definitions, field processing, and the conversion logic required for entity handling and AST matching operations.
responsibilities: Verifying data conversion logic for entities
Ensuring correctness of CRUD schema definitions
Testing date handling logic within entities
relationships: CRUD schema definitions govern how entities are structured and validated during runtime operations.
Data conversion logic relies on defined entity fields to transform internal representations into required formats.
AST matchers utilize the defined entity structure to identify and validate specific patterns within the entity data.
designDecisions: Collocation of test files with source logic to ensure comprehensive coverage of entity behaviors.
Isolation of unit tests for specific sub-components like date parsing, schema generation, and validation rules.
Use of specialized matchers to verify complex tree structures within entity ASTs.
